label: Change Makers
notes: Change Makers: gameId change-makers matches registry (export ChangeMakersGame). 84 scenarios faithfully mapped from GDD 34 JSON: 6 cats (find-your-cause/make-the-plan/build-the-movement/the-law-as-a-tool/make-it-stick/launch-it), 7 types (branch 28/reflect 17/sort 14/strike-rewrite 10/match 6/role-play 5/spot 4), 0% binary. Scales Lead the Way into organised collective change: cause->plan->movement->law-as-tool->impact->safe first step. Change is possible AND practical; nothing meaningful alone; activism safe/lawful/non-violent/ethical/sustainable; sensitive causes backed by trusted adults/institutions. India laws (DV Act 2005, POSH 2013, Dowry Prohibition, BNS 2023) + helplines 181/1098/112 (reassureCats the-law-as-a-tool+make-it-stick). binStyle: added too vague/over-reach/stalls it/just noise/risks it->red + real impact/actionable/good partner/lawful & ethical/real protection->green; collision-free (none in existing content); only genuinely good/bad bins colored, nuanced 'not-yet' bins (Still planning/Not the priority/Beyond a first project) + categorisation bin cm-019 (advocacy vs awareness) left neutral by design. Spot ids injected (4).
